summary.ja: 非線形方程式 F(x)=0 を、Jacobianから求めたNewton方向と残差ノルムの十分減少による減衰で解く。公開例は密行列解法または前処理付きGMRESの内部解法を選べる。 追加固定例：擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：同じ難しい初期値に対する線探索と信頼領域。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：離散fold近傍のBratu感度、分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Solve F(x)=0 using a Jacobian-based Newton direction and damping that requires sufficient decrease of the residual norm. The example supports a dense or preconditioned GMRES inner solve. assumptions: The caller supplies F and its Jacobian; the basic setting is a square differentiable system with a nonsingular Jacobian near the root.
Starting at one, the step is halved until ||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂; failure is returned below α=2⁻²⁰.
The GMRES path still uses an explicitly supplied Jacobian; CSR uses ILU(0), otherwise Jacobi preconditioning. Inner and outer absolute residual criteria differ.
units: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.
boundary_conditions: Newton has no intrinsic physical boundary. F/Jacobian assembly supplies it; the existing Bratu test encodes zero Dirichlet values at both ends of [0,1].

limitations.en: Convergence depends on the initial guess, Jacobian nonsingularity and residual scaling; global convergence is not guaranteed. Singular dense solves or preconditioner construction may raise exceptions rather than return a failure reason. No matrix-free Jv, trust region or continuation is provided. Additional fixed examples: A small one-dimensional simple fold only. summary.en: Follow the lower and upper branches of the same one-dimensional Bratu boundary-value problem; check tangents, the fold and spatial error against an independent analytic family.

assumptions.ja: 無次元x∈[0,1]、両端u=0、中心差分の内点31/63/127。零解から固定ds=0.1で80step。λ=2で上下枝を補正し、λ=4は離散無解の意図的な対照です。擬似弧長は物理時間ではありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time.

algorithm.ja: hΣdu²+dλ²の重み付き単位接線、予測点と接線超平面によるNewton補正。別の拡大系でfoldと正規化null vectorを解きます。このcaseは疎Jacobianを明示的に組み立てます。
algorithm.en: Use a unit tangent in h-sum(du squared)+d-lambda squared, a predictor and a tangent-hyperplane Newton corrector. A separate augmented system locates the fold and a normalized null vector. This case deliberately assembles sparse Jacobians.

validation.ja: 保存R3では共通27pytestと本caseの67固定判定が合格。離散残差、接線の向き・単位長、fold方程式・null条件・transversality、独立Decimal80解析族、固定3格子の誤差を別々に確認しています。
validation.en: The preserved R3 run passed the shared 27 pytest tests and this case’s 67 fixed gates. Discrete residuals, tangent orientation/normalization, fold/null/transversality conditions, an independent Decimal80 family and fixed three-grid errors are checked separately.

limits.ja: 小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。

title.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

summary.ja: 離散Bratuのfoldへ近づく6固定点で、状態誤差と線形許容差の影響を分け、独立shooting勾配と照合します。
summary.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.

assumptions.ja: 内点31/63、離散fold anchorとの差.1/.01/.001。各状態は零初期値からの下枝。λの文字列を一度binary floatへ変換し、参照はその正確な値をDecimalで評価します。
assumptions.en: 31/63 interior nodes; gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor. Every state starts at zero on the lower branch. Parse each lambda string once to binary float; the Decimal oracle evaluates exactly that float.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. title.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
title.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

summary.ja: 2重みだけの局所hat作用で8/16/32個の空間係数を表し、目的関数ごとの随伴VJPを全感度参照と比較します。
summary.en: Represent8/16/32 spatial controls with two local hat weights per node; compare objective-wise adjoint VJPs with a separate full-sensitivity reference.

assumptions.ja: 内点63、a(x)=2+Bθ、θ=.2sin(2πξ)+.1cos(πξ)。uと感度は固定零Dirichlet境界ですが、係数の両端controlは固定零ではありません。
assumptions.en: 63 interior nodes; a(x)=2+B theta with theta=.2sin(2pi xi)+.1cos(pi xi). State/sensitivity have fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints; endpoint coefficient controls are not fixed zero.

algorithm.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window.
